_doc: Book-walk vectors shared by EngineLens (Solidity, test/engine/Lens.t.sol) and the TS book-math mirror. Regenerated from Agari 03b30ab anchor/tests/vectors/book.vectors.json with the rest filter in seconds (placedAt/minRestSec, 1:1 onto Agari's slots) by scripts/fixtures/book-vectors-seconds.mjs; do not edit by hand. `sol` holds live orders as flat [price, lots, expireTs, placedAt]… and expected levels as [price, lots]….

cases.name: BUY_NO takes bids inverted, SELL_NO hits asks inverted
expired, dead and unrested orders are skipped (all counted)
rested_only counts only orders rested ≥ 50 s
quote_stake stops on a partial level: 2 USDC over 540×2,000, 560×5,000 → 3,472 lots @ 576
BUY_NO quote over a 620 bid: 1 USDC → 2,557 lots, YES price 609
min_lots refuses a quote that fits only 1 lot; cu = 2 scales cash
n caps the levels returned; an empty side is empty
